materialization_rules.T1a_ACRONYM: exact short-long relation; reject same-context same-short distinct-long ambiguity
materialization_rules.T2_NUMERIC: same-paragraph unique hard-pass numeric target plus unique 8-word lexical prefix anchor
materialization_rules.T3_CLAIM: same-paragraph unique MV claim; include all frozen support evidence intact
materialization_rules.context_crop: deterministic target/anchor-centered token window; no partial required support
materialization_rules.dedup: exact instruction+context+response within split, keep lowest stable order

ordering.method: paper round-robin; at most 3 instances per paper in N2000

split.method: SHA256(seed|source_id), ascending, first 1500 train, last 400 eval

reasons: cannot uniformly support the 2,000-instance upper scale
external validation scope is weaker than T1a

templates.T1a_ACRONYM: What does {SHORT_FORM} stand for in the passage?
templates.T2_NUMERIC: According to the passage, what value is reported immediately after {ANCHOR}?
templates.T3_CLAIM:
Extract the scientific finding stated in the passage.
Preserve the wording, conditions, polarity, negation,
and uncertainty expressed in the evidence.
